summary: Frontend-only regression of new features (Practice Mode, Badges, Dark Mode). Registered two fresh students via /register UI and executed real gameplay for Food quiz (level 6), Alphabet PairMatch (level 1) and Colors (level 3). Verified badge derivation, map badge strip counter, dark-mode toggle+persistence, and certificate rebrand. Practice-mode isolation from POST /api/progress verified end-to-end by intercepting network requests.
critical_code_review_comments: getInitialTheme() defaults to 'light' and the useEffect always writes data-theme attribute (never absent). The spec allowed 'absent/light or dark' -- current implementation always sets one of ['light','dark']. This is fine functionally.

AuthContext.saveProgress: 'before' snapshot is captured from progressRef.current BEFORE awaiting POST; but during the await another saveProgress could double-fire toast. Low risk in current UX (single-game flow) but worth guarding.

PairMatchGame.handlePractice filters original items by failed Set; because wrongPair marks BOTH sides of the mismatched pair as failed, the practice pool can grow larger than intended (e.g. 1 wrong click => 2 items in practice, which matched observed behavior 'Practicar los errores (2)'). Consider tracking only the intended-left target item to keep 'N wrong = N practice items' semantics consistent with QuizGame/ColorsGame.
test_credentials: admin@englishkids.com / admin1234 (not used); ephemeral test users registered per run.
seed_data_creation: For Food quiz practice test, seeded levels 2-5 via POST /api/progress to unlock level 6, then cleared the request-tracker before the actual test.
verified_features: Initial /badges shows 7 cards all in 'locked' class
Dark mode: click toggles html[data-theme] between light/dark, localStorage 'ek-theme' updated, persists across reload

Food quiz (level 6, 18Q): played through with 15 wrong. Result panel shows result-practice with '(15)'. Clicking replayed only 15 items with progress text 'Práctica · Question · Pregunta 1 / 15' and practice-tag on subsequent result. Exactly 1 POST /api/progress observed (initial run), zero POSTs during practice. Saved level 6 progress (score=3, stars=0) unchanged after practice.

Alphabet PairMatch (level 1): introduced 1 wrong pair click => result-practice shows (2). Completing level saves progress (score=26/26, stars=2). first_step badge earned (class contains 'earned'); map-badge-count updates from '0 / 7' to '1 / 7'.

Colors (level 3): one intentional wrong => result-practice (1). Practice replays only that color; completing practice with 0 wrong shows practice-tag and NO result-practice button. Zero POST /api/progress during practice.
Certificate page still shows 'English Kids' and no 'SENA' branding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toast '¡Nueva medalla!' fires via sonner but auto-dismisses; DOM query after game returned 0 toast elements (expected). To assert toast text directly, intercept toast events at emit-time (patch window.__sonner or listen for [data-sonner-toast] mutations during saveProgress). PairMatch's 'failed' Set includes both sides of a mismatch, so 1 bad click yields wrongCount=2 in the practice button label -- confirmed behavior, flagged as code-review item. Gold_star badge could not be validated in this run because deliberate wrong matches capped level 1 at 2 stars.
